isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify Dynamic Master Router's POST /tool/execute call for skill_index 1 of Standard_BOM_Flow, immediately after a BOM file is uploaded via upload_server.py's POST /api/rfq/upload. Action: validate rfq_id, resolve the registered BOM file path from rfq_file_telemetry (file_role='BOM', active row for the current version), run process_scrub_bom_workbook() to map/standardize the 'SCRUB BOM'/'Settings'/'Batch' sheets, and write the results to DuckDB's scrub_bom_items/volume/batch tables under a cross-process lock. Check: rfq_id matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ before any SQL use, and all 3 table writes individually report status=='success'. Bound: single attempt only -- no retry loop exists in the implementation; any exception is caught and returned as status:'failed' with a traceback, not retried. Business rule: performs schema mapping and standardization only -- volume expansion, consolidation, and duplicate-CPN detection are explicitly out of scope for this tool.

required_inputs: A row in file_metadata_db.rfq_file_telemetry with file_role='BOM', is_active=true, for (rfq_id, version) -- the BOM workbook file path
fresh_state_parameters: version (integer, default 1; resolved by fastapi_router.py from file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking's active version before this tool is called)
Whether scrub_bom_items/volume/batch rows already exist for this rfq_id+version (drives the already_processed no-op path)

a_automation.action_step: Fetch the BOM file path via the postgres_metadata__execute_sql MCP tool, run process_scrub_bom_workbook(bom_file), then write scrub_bom_items/volume/batch to DuckDB inside db.duckdb_file_lock().
a_automation.acceptance_check: Programmatically evaluate whether every one of the 3 per-table write results has status=='success'; overall_status is 'success' only if all 3 agree.

t_tech_stack.action_tool: standardize_scrub_bom (this tool itself, plus process_scrub_bom_workbook / process_scrub_bom_to_database / process_volume_to_database / process_batch_to_database helper functions)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists. Validation (_validate_id() regex guard, per-table status checks) is inline Python inside this same function, not delegated to a separate tool.

v_variables.no_op_condition: already_processed==true for this rfq_id+version -- i.e. every one of the 3 tables' rows already existed from a prior run (scrub_mcp_server.py's own idempotency check); on this path hitl is deliberately NOT re-asserted
v_variables.escalation_condition: hitl:1 in the response on a FRESH (non-already_processed) success -- halts the DMR pipeline (fastapi_router.py will not advance rfq_process_stage) until a human uploads QuoteWin/Costing Sheet via the frontend's RfqErpQuoteWinUploadModal
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s read timeout on the MCP Jungle call_tool() request (tool_calling.py) / 600s on the Dify HTTP Request node that calls /tool/execute -- two independent, unsynced timeout values, both real

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: No dedicated append-only audit table exists in the current implementation (unlike an ideal ISATVON audit artifact). The real state handoff is: (1) the written scrub_bom_items/volume/batch DuckDB rows themselves, (2) file_metadata_db.rfq_file_telemetry.execution_logs (jsonb, appended to by upload_server.py, not this tool), and (3) PostHog analytics events (upload_processing_started/completed/failed) fired by this tool. Flagged as a gap against ISATVON's audit-artifact expectation, not silently assumed to exist.

ui_updates: Generic {skillCode:'M03.1_ScrubBOMStandardize', skillName:'Standardize SCRUB BOM Workbook', macroCategory, stepStatus:'running'} pushed via fastapi_router.py's notify_skill_progress() before the tool call
Same payload with stepStatus:'completed' after a successful (non-hitl, non-failed) advance, or stepStatus:'failed' with an error string on failure
No fixed message strings (e.g. 'Looping [Pass X/Y]') exist in this code -- the frontend (accomplish-ui) renders its own UI text from this generic payload
database_updates: file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking.rfq_process_stage incremented by fastapi_router.py only when hitl is falsy
file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking.hitl_required set true by fastapi_router.py when this tool returns hitl:1
alerts: None confirmed in code beyond the SSE progress events above -- no separate escalation/paging channel exists for this tool

persistence.database: DuckDB (input_db.duckdb) for output tables; PostgreSQL file_metadata_db for file-path lookup and pipeline-state updates
persistence.table: scrub_bom_items, volume, batch (DuckDB, written); rfq_file_telemetry (Postgres, read); rfq_process_tracking (Postgres, written by the caller, not this tool directly)
persistence.action: Direct DuckDB writes under db.duckdb_file_lock(); Postgres file-path read via postgres_metadata__execute_sql MCP tool

audit.telemetry: PostHog_Analytics_Events (upload_processing_started/completed/failed) -- no PostgreSQL audit-log table exists for this tool

ui.method: SSE push via the daemon's rfq:skill-progress channel, sourced from fastapi_router.py's notify_skill_progress()
